content.comment_body: One instruction can be swapped with another using drag-and-drop, as shown in the attached animated GIF. When the replacement is fully compatible, it is indicated in green. Compatibility issues are shown in red. Some block-to-block replacements are not supported, which are not highlighted.

Hello [user_name], Thank you for providing this information. This feature will save users significant time, and I wasn’t aware of it before. Was this drag-and-drop feature available in older versions or only in [product_name] [version_no]? I'm asking out of curiosity, as I do not have access to previous versions to confirm myself.

analysis.insight_summary: Users appreciate the drag-and-drop instruction replacement feature in [product_name] for making workflows more efficient. Positive feedback points to the time-saving aspect, but some users are unsure about its availability in earlier versions, indicating a need for clearer documentation and communication about software updates and compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear details on which versions of [product_name] support the drag-and-drop instruction replacement feature, and expect feature visibility to be improved within the documentation for better awareness.
